subject: Action needed: BOTH Hermes watchdogs are dark
ticket_title: Both Hermes watchdogs dark — reported by neb-ops-gcp
runbook: Both Hermes watchdogs have stopped reporting, so nothing is monitoring either bot.
This alert only fires when EVERY watched box is dark. While one is up it reports
the other itself, so a single failure never reaches this host.
gcloud compute ssh hermes-tmn --project teamnebula-os --zone us-central1-a \
Likely causes, in order: both boxes are genuinely off or unreachable; Tailscale
is down on this host so neither heartbeat resolves; or the heartbeat servers were
stopped without the checks being stopped.
context_note: neb-ops-gcp is a backstop and nothing watches it in turn. If this host dies, the
coverage silently degrades to the two boxes watching each other, which is where
things stood before 2026-08-17 — still good for a single box going dark.
